card.name: Cardiac drug text, before heart terms
card.fires_on: Mixed positions in heart-rhythm drug labels (ivabradine, digoxin, ibutilide, adenosine, MULTAQ): numbers in heart rate ranges, spaces after commas or before numbers, and small words like 'of', 'to', 'in'. The next word is often about heart rate or rhythm.

modes.label: Heart rate numbers
modes.description: Numbers and spaces inside target heart rate ranges or confidence intervals.

modes.description: Small words or word starts in sentences about treating tachycardia or atrial arrhythmias.

card.writes: It suppresses the word heart in English and Chinese, so it seems to hold back 'heart' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires in heart-drug labels at spots where the word 'heart' might come next, and it pushes that word down.
